title: Nepal’s New Government Calls Elections. Its Critics Cry Foul.
summary: Sushila Karki, a former Supreme Court chief justice who was appointed as interim leader, made speed a priority in a process that other jurists deem unconstitutional.

title: Anti-Israel protests turn Spanish Vuelta cycling race into a diplomatic battleground
summary: Protests targeting an Israeli-owned team have seized the limelight at Spain's version of the Tour de France. The team under fire issued a statement saying that quitting the race is out of the question.
